comment: Per-platform pinned Native references. No tool writes this file: compat/capabilities.json is rewritten by compat:report with whatever reference the host built, so it cannot pin anything. Tests resolve the local .build/reference to exactly one entry here through tests/helpers/reference-identity.ts (tools/differential-runner/reference-identity.mjs) and fail when it matches none. 'source' names the tracked evidence record that first recorded these artifacts; 'libraries' are the sha256 of the static libraries of a build whose ffmpeg and ffprobe equal the pin. See docs/contributing/linux-reference.md.

darwin-arm64.librariesSource: macOS arm64 .build/reference whose ffmpeg and ffprobe equal this pin and whose libraries and fftools objects reproduce the link-input digest 64c7ae24... pinned in tools/bootstrap/lock.json; libavutil.a b8864b17... is also the librarySha256 of compat/behavior-specs/default-channel-layout/provenance.json

linux-x64.librariesSource: the isolated container build in .build/linux-x64/reference (tools/upstream-build/linux.mjs, completed 2026-11-20) whose ffmpeg and ffprobe equal this pin; the GitHub reference job must reproduce them once it builds from the n9.0.2 tag
